verdict.rationale: Vanta's first-party pages describe in-product AI that turns customer data into insights and suggestions. Vanta AI reviews evidence, flags gaps and suggests fixes; the Vanta AI Agent flags issues before they escalate and supports agentic search and Q&A across policies, controls, frameworks, tests and documents. It also generates questionnaire responses from your own knowledge base and extracts findings from vendor SOC 2 reports. missing for 10: in-depth product documentation of how the AI insights and suggestions work (the evidence is marketing-level only), independent or hands-on corroboration of suggestion quality.
